name: Run a cross-citation search around seeds
route: POST /api/cross-citations/queries/{id}/search-plan → POST …/runs {searches[{key, url, q, practice}]} → GET /api/scholar/url-works
cost_note: ≈ 2 Scholar pages + 1 cheap LLM per search; one advanced call for the plan
side_effects: run rows, search history, practice evidence
yields: works citing or cited by the seeds together
